title: Network slice-specific EAP result message transport procedure initiation

entities.name: Network slice-specific EAP result message transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for transporting EAP authentication results (success/failure) for specific network slices between AMF and UE.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: Message used to transport EAP authentication results for specific network slices from AMF to UE.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: IE containing either EAP-success or EAP-failure message provided by AAA-S via NSSAAF.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: IE containing either HPLMN S-NSSAI or SNPN S-NSSAI to which the EAP result is related.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP authentication success message provided by AAA-S via NSSAAF.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP authentication failure message provided by AAA-S via NSSAAF.

entities.name: Authentication result retention
entities.description: AMF retains authentication result for UE and HPLMN S-NSSAI/SNPN S-NSSAI while UE is registered to PLMN.

entities.name: Upper layer passing
entities.description: UE passes EAP result and S-NSSAI to upper layers upon receiving NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.

relations.description: Procedure initiation involves creating and sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.
NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains EAP message IE.
NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains S-NSSAI IE.
EAP message IE can contain EAP-success message.
EAP message IE can contain EAP-failure message.
Procedure establishes that AMF retains authentication result while UE is registered.
Receipt of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message triggers UE to pass EAP result and S-NSSAI to upper layers.
